messages:
amy_csm: Heads-up — seeing 5xx failures for EU onboarding/index writes for ~110 tenants between ~11:05–11:40 UTC. Drafting a short customer note, need quick review.

amy_csm: ```
Subject: Status update — EU onboarding interruption

Hi,

Earlier today (approx 11:05–11:40 UTC) some EU onboarding and indexing requests returned errors. Root cause: an auth-sync config propagation race producing token validation errors for certain flows.

Mitigation: rollback and hotfix deployed at 11:28 UTC. Automated reprocessing ran 11:35–12:10 UTC.

Impact: ~110 tenants experienced failed onboarding or partial index writes. We do not expect permanent data loss; we will replay any remaining items with affected customers.

Support: affected customers will receive one month of account credit. Renewal customers: contact your AE for a tailored remediation plan (extensions, credits, or technical replay).

Status page: https://status.redwood.ai

Thanks — Amy, Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

ben_support: +1 on tone. Add line: "If you onboarded via SSO/VPC and still see failures, reply here and we'll prioritize an engineering replay." Also include support portal link.

diego_eng: RCA summary: control-plane retry storm + TTL race on config propagation caused expired token handoffs for ~3% of EU onboarding requests. Hotfix at 11:28, safety rollback at 11:36. Backfills completed for ~97% of affected writes; remaining ~3% flagged for manual replay.

priya_ae: I'll take ownership of communicating with renewal-risk accounts after the message goes out. Prefer AE-managed remedies over blanket credits for renewals.

ops-bot: Incident logged INC-20260322-1105  severity=P2  owners=eng-oncall,cs-ops

amy_csm: Great, sending at 14:00 UTC and posting to the status page. If anyone has urgent edits, reply here before send. :thumbsup:
